Name: Chaos Studio Scenario Runner
Description: Least-privilege role for the Chaos Studio v2 CI/CD integrations (GitHub Action + Azure Pipelines task): validate, execute, poll, and cancel scenario configurations. Grants exactly the five source-proven Microsoft.Chaos operations the integration invokes (drawn from the generated Operations_List snapshot, VF9/VF12/DX1) — no workspace/scenario/configuration write or delete, and no data actions. RV2 (test/release-validation/rbac-role-template.test.ts) fails closed if this role grants any operation outside that set or omits a required one.
